Name: Blast Fishing
Author: wulinbiji
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/47588/47588-1781332534-1710426201.gif[/img]



中文介绍
Blast Fishing 是一个偏爽感和视觉演出的炸鱼 Mod。它新增了专属的爆鱼水雷，也支持樱桃炸弹、炸弹和超级炸弹投进水里使用。手持水雷或炸弹时，左键点击水面即可按抛物线投掷；也可以使用默认快捷键 G 投掷，快捷键可以在 Generic Mod Config Menu 里修改。
主要功能
[list]
[*]专属爆鱼水雷，可在威利鱼店购买。[/*]
[*]鼠标指向水面后左键投掷，或按快捷键 G 投掷。[/*]
[*]水雷只能投到水面，避免误放到地上。[/*]
[*]爆炸会产生巨大的像素风水柱、飞溅水花、落水音效和暴雨效果。[/*]
[*]暴雨会浇湿耕地，也可以显示临时的地面湿润效果。[/*]
[*]可开启鱼雨，让鱼从天空落到农夫附近。[/*]
[*]鱼获数量可配置，默认 10，范围 0 到 500。[/*]
[*]默认只掉鱼，不掉垃圾和其他水域物品。[/*]
[*]可配置是否允许垃圾、海草/藻类等其他物品。[/*]
[*]可配置鱼的品质：任意、普通、银星、金星、铱星。[/*]
[*]可选“任何水域可能出鱼王”，开启后任意水域都有少量概率获得原版鱼王和齐先生任务的二代鱼王。[/*]
[*]水柱颜色会根据当前水域颜色进行调整。[/*]
[*]支持中文和多语言翻译文件。[/*]
[/list]默认设置
[list]
[*]默认快捷键：G[/*]
[*]默认鱼获数量：10[/*]
[*]默认只掉鱼[/*]
[*]默认不掉垃圾[/*]
[*]默认不掉其他物品[/*]
[*]默认关闭任意水域出鱼王[/*]
[*]默认开启鱼雨和水面特效[/*]
[/list]需求
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu 可选，但推荐安装，用于在游戏内调整配置。[/*]
[/list]安卓说明
安卓端选中爆鱼水雷后，点击水面即可投掷。点击地面不会放置水雷，避免出现放到地上后拿不起来的问题。
兼容性
这个 Mod 主要新增一个物品、商店售卖项、输入逻辑和视觉效果，不替换地图和原版物品。联机时建议主机和农场成员都安装，保证投掷、掉落和特效同步体验一致。
English Description
Blast Fishing is a spectacle-focused fishing mod built around water explosions, water mines, fish rain, and oversized pixel-art splash effects. It adds a dedicated Water Mine item, and also lets you throw Cherry Bombs, Bombs, and Mega Bombs into water. Hold a water mine or bomb, then left-click a water tile to throw it in an arc. You can also use the default hotkey G, which can be changed through Generic Mod Config Menu.
Main Features
[list]
[*]Adds a dedicated Water Mine item, sold at Willy's Fish Shop.[/*]
[*]Left-click water to throw the held water mine or bomb.[/*]
[*]Optional throw hotkey, default G.[/*]
[*]Water Mines can only be thrown into water, preventing accidental ground placement.[/*]
[*]Huge pixel-art water plume with splash effects, water impact sounds, and storm visuals.[/*]
[*]Blast rain waters tilled soil and can show temporary wet ground effects.[/*]
[*]Optional fish rain, making rewards fall from the sky around the farmer.[/*]
[*]Configurable reward count, default 10, range 0 to 500.[/*]
[*]Defaults to fish-only rewards.[/*]
[*]Configurable trash and other water-item drops.[/*]
[*]Configurable fish quality: Any, Normal, Silver, Gold, or Iridium.[/*]
[*]Optional legendary fish anywhere setting. When enabled, any water has a small chance to produce the original legendary fish and their Qi challenge relatives.[/*]
[*]Water plume color adapts to the current water color.[/*]
[*]Includes Chinese and other translation files.[/*]
[/list]Default Settings
[list]
[*]Default hotkey: G[/*]
[*]Default reward count: 10[/*]
[*]Fish rewards enabled by default[/*]
[*]Trash disabled by default[/*]
[*]Other water items disabled by default[/*]
[*]Legendary fish anywhere disabled by default[/*]
[*]Fish rain and water effects enabled by default[/*]
[/list]Requirements
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional, but recommended for in-game configuration.[/*]
[/list]Android Notes
On Android, select the Water Mine and tap a water tile to throw it. Tapping land will not place the Water Mine on the ground.
Compatibility
This mod mainly adds one item, a shop entry, input handling, reward logic, and visual effects. It does not replace maps or vanilla items. For multiplayer, the host and farmhands should all install the mod for consistent throwing, rewards, and effects.
